name: ApplicantStack
summary: ApplicantStack prices per account rather than per user, from $29.99 a month for one open job to $109.99 for unlimited jobs and $159.99 for the Bundle. Trials show only the first 100 candidates, and candidate texting costs extra at amounts the page does not list.

facts.text: ApplicantStack says it uploads job posts and updates to Indeed, JobTarget and more.
Its candidate management page describes triggers for each stage of the hiring process, scheduling emails and interviews, and scorecards the hiring team uses to rate applicants.
According to the pricing FAQ, there are no required setup costs and no contract or cancellation fee.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 1 active job at a time, 1 admin seat and 5 hiring manager seats.

plans.name: Recruit
plans.notes: Unlimited jobs. More admin and hiring manager seats can be added.

plans.name: Bundle
plans.notes: Unlimited jobs. The Bundle button says Learn More, so a trial is not stated for it.

hiddenCosts: Candidate Texting and Premium Candidate Texting carry an additional fee on every plan, with no amount listed.
During the free trial you can view only the first 100 candidates.
